inputs.text:
Look at the absolute state of this system and the deep structural injustices baked into our federal agencies. Newly filed court documents reveal that lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Think about the profound vulnerability of these marginalized individuals, targeted simply as they were seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. 

Now, we are learning from federal prosecutors that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show, despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. This whole mess was revealed in a lawsuit challenging the practice of targeting people. This is a glaring example of institutional abuse and dishonesty deployed against vulnerable populations. When the apparatus of the state operates with this kind of systemic deception, it protects no one and instead actively harms communities, showing that the entire system is in urgent need of radical reform and true accountability to stop these abuses of power.
